KINGDOM HEARTS 4 - COCO Reveal and Release Window Trailer | D23 Showcase
A brand-new adventure awaits as the world of Disney and Pixar's Coco joins KINGDOM HEARTS IV.

KINGDOM HEARTS IV is now available to wishlist on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox ON PC, Nintendo Switch™ 2, Steam, and Epic Games Store coming late 2027!
